items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, I can say I played with Teddy Wilson (laughs).

ctx.x: No. That settles that right away! (Laughs) Tatum was in a class all by himself in every way: harmonically, technique, stamina.
Did you have a personal relationship with Wilson? Did you come to have one?

No. Once I did a concert in Canada and the group was under the leadership of Teddy Wilson, a small group. Max Roach was in the group by the way, and J.J. Johnson. It was sort of an all-star group. But, I went up there to play during the intermission while the band was off the stage. So, I can say I played with Teddy Wilson (laughs). That’s funny.
